hero.title: Café Le Den
hero.subtitle: Homemade with love since 1994
hero.description: Fresh bread baked daily, specialty lattes you won't find anywhere else, and homemade meals crafted with care.

about.title: Our story
about.description: For over 30 years, Café Le Den has been the neighbourhood's living room in Valois Village. Run by Gina and Josh, we bake our bread fresh every morning, simmer our soups from scratch, and craft specialty drinks with care. From the pistachio latte to our famous hot and sour soup, every item is made by hand with the finest ingredients.

menu.title: Our menu
menu.cartLimit: Your cart has reached the online order limit. Review it before adding more.

order.title: Your order
order.pickupTimeDescription: Choose when you'd like to pick up your order
order.nameRequired: Enter a pickup name (up to 100 characters)
order.estimateNotice: This is an estimate. The café verifies current items, options, taxes, and total before accepting your order.
order.payInPerson: Payment is collected in person at pickup.
order.errorSubmitting: We couldn’t place your order. Your cart is saved. Check your connection and try again.
order.errorService: Ordering is temporarily unavailable. Your cart is saved. Please try again in a few minutes.
order.errorOrderDetails: Your order may have been received, but we couldn’t confirm its details. Keep your cart and call the cafe before trying again.
order.errorHours: Pickup is no longer available at that time. Choose another available time and try again.
order.errorMenuChanged: A menu item or price changed. Review the menu and update your cart before trying again.
order.errorChallenge: We could not verify this request. Complete a fresh verification and try the same order again.
order.errorInputLimits: Review your contact details and cart limits: up to 50 lines, 20 of one line, and 100 items total.
order.errorRateLimited: There have been several attempts. Wait a moment, then verify and try again.

challenge.ready: Verification complete. You can place the order.
challenge.expired: Verification expired. Start a fresh check.
challenge.unavailable: Verification is unavailable. Your order details are still saved on this page.

order.checkingReceiptTitle: Checking whether your order was accepted
order.checkingReceiptBody: Do not submit again. We’re using your private order key to look for the receipt.
order.notFoundBody: It is safe to retry this same order after completing a fresh verification.
order.verifyAndRetry: Verify and retry the same order
order.uncertainTitle: We still can’t confirm the receipt
order.uncertainBody: Do not submit again. Keep this page open and call the café so staff can check manually.
order.acceptedFallbackBody: Order {order}, total {total}. This browser could not save the private status link. Do not submit again; keep this page open and call the café if you need help.

confirmation.title: Order placed
confirmation.thankYou: Thank you. Your order has been sent to the cafe.
confirmation.paymentNote: Please pay in person when you pick up your order.
confirmation.legacyBody: For privacy, an order number alone cannot open an order. Use the private order-status link saved when you placed the order.
confirmation.legacyPrivacy: If you no longer have the private link, call the café. Staff can help without exposing customer details online.

status.title: Your private order status
status.acceptedTruth: Your accepted order is in the café queue.
status.recoveredReceipt: We recovered the receipt after the original response was interrupted.
status.staleLastKnown: We could not refresh. The status shown is the last confirmed update.
status.pullOnly: This page checks for updates while it is open and visible. It does not send push notifications.
status.cancelledCall: Call the café about this cancellation: {phone}
status.saveLinkBody: Closing this tab without saving the link ends self-service tracking. Anyone with the link can see this order’s PII-free status.
status.phoneCancellation: The café may call the phone number you submitted if an accepted order must be cancelled.
status.remove: Remove this order from this browser
status.removedBody: This browser no longer holds the private tracking key.
status.unavailableBody: This link is invalid, expired, revoked, or missing. No order details are available.
